scheme_name: Support for Value Addition - Support to R&G units
other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual unit, partnership firm, self‑help group or growers’ collective interested in establishing a new coffee roasting, grinding or packaging unit.
The unit must hold a valid business license from the respective statutory authorities.
Subsidy is only for the establishment of new R&G units, not for additional or duplicate machinery of the same type.
Only the specified combinations of roasting, grinding and packaging machines are eligible for subsidy.
Applications are considered on a first‑come, first‑served basis subject to fund availability.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 40% (up to ₹10,00,000) for regular applicants and 50% (up to ₹10,00,000) for women, SC/ST, minorities and differently‑abled beneficiaries on eligible coffee roasting, grinding and packaging machinery.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
